question: why the AI holds other provinces from the same save

addresses.name: CAIUnit::RebuildHoldProvinces
addresses.comment: **Slot 80**, 0x4B3A50 to the bare `ret` at 0x4B41F0. CAIUnit::Tick calls it through [vftable+0x140] at 0x4B0A99 (Ghidra's `vf_80`) - so the tick's two calls after slot 78 are slot 79 ManageExpeditions at 0x4B0A36 and slot 80 this. It clears the CList at +0x17C and refills it, kept in descending score order (CList_InsertByDescendingScore) with 0x1C-byte records {province, 0, score}: (1) every objective of the agent's unit's plan (CUnit +0x234) whose province's controller is on our side (IsSameSide) or a co-belligerent that is not an enemy, scored 0x4B4200(this, province) **plus the objective's priority (CObjective +0xC, read at 0x4B3C64)**; (2) every focus province of the owner AI (CEU3AI +0x118) that we control, or whose controller we are not at war with (neither REB, and no undeclared war covering it), scored 0x4B4200 plus 200.0; then sets +0x82. For a theatre agent (or no unit) of a country that is not a subject: the provinces of each focus owner area (+0x338) belonging to a puppet of ours where none of that puppet's land units stands or is heading, and the provinces of the theatre's +0x60 list, each kept when 0x4B4200 reaches 0.1, the score rounded to a whole number. Last, the list is cut from the tail to max(land units +0x11C minus non-division units +0x14C, the objective and focus count). Read by slot 86 (0x4C7CA7). The name is ours and only the shape is read; 0x4B4200's score is not. **On the listing, 2026-11-10: a subject (CCountry +0xF34) skips only the puppets' focus areas, and goes on to the theatre's +0x60 provinces.** The set the objectives and focus provinces went into is asked of the puppets' and the theatre's provinces and not added to, so a province in both comes twice. The score is rounded by fistp, so a half to the even. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 15.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled from the running game, 0x8B3E5F to 0x8B4150; Nanning HQ's list in memory holds 7553, 7586, 7585, 7573 and 7596 twice each.
addresses.revises: the subject gate and the duplicates

addresses.name: CAIUnit_ProvinceHoldValue
addresses.signature: float __stdcall CAIUnit_ProvinceHoldValue(CMapProvince* province@ECX, CAIUnit* agent@stack:4, bool withSupplyAndShips@stack:8) @XMM0
addresses.comment: **What one of our provinces is worth holding, as a float** - the per-province term of EstimateAreaNeed's second estimate (N2 = sum / min(provinces, 40)), and the term CAIUnit_ScoreHoldProvince (0x4B4200) adds. 0x4B9710 to the `ret 8` at 0x4B9E9F, the answer in XMM0 (both callers read xmm0 straight after the call). C = the agent's country. 0 when the province's MaxInfrastructure < 200. near = some edge not of kind 3 reaches a simulated land province whose controller K is not C.IsFriend(K, true) and has threat >= 100.0 - K's strategy threat towards C (CAIStrategy::GetThreat, 0x4A4DC0), plus C's antagonism of K (GetAntagonism, 0x4A4E00) when C is at peace (+0xACC), its CEU3AI runs_units is set and !withSupplyAndShips - or is front-worthy to C (IsFrontWorthyEnemy); the walk stops at the first. full = 1 except for USA at war while ENG owns provinces and is not in exile and USA's core VP owned minus held (+0xBE0 - +0xBE4) is under 2000. v = near ? 3 * FORT_LEVEL (modifier 10, whole levels) : 0; full and COASTAL_FORT_LEVEL cf > 0: v += 5 * (cf + 1); w = full ? air base level_max : 0, plus, full and naval base level_max n > 0: (C is GER or ITA ? x = 10n + 30, above 100 -> (x - 100) / 5 + 90 : n); w x 2.0 when the province is not in its controller's capital area and its area has under 15 provinces; v += w. Victory points vp > 0: owned by C -> v += max(2vp + 5, vp * 100.0 / (C.victory_points_owned (+0xBDC) / 1000.0)); controlled by C and owned by a country not in exile -> v += 2vp + 5. C's acting capital: +100. full and a real strategic resource (+0x18, slot 14): +60. x = province IC (modifier 15) / 1000.0 * 0.5; r = max(effective revolt risk (GetProvinceEffectiveRevoltRisk, 0xA4050), max(minimum_revolt_risk (modifier 0), 0)) / 1000.0. Without the flag v += x; with it: +100 for the province's own supply depot (+0x48 == id), v += r * x, and full with a naval base and a naval station (+0x58): v += 30 + 2 x its ships (CUnitList::GetTotalNumOfShips, 0x1D5CC0). Finally + 0.25 x the priority of the plan's objective on the province, if any. Two callers: EstimateAreaNeed (0x4B8FD2, flag 0) and CAIUnit_ScoreHoldProvince (0x4B4670, flag 1). The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-moving.md, section C. **The ships are those of the fleets based at the port**, wherever they are at sea (its naval station's list), not those in the province: with that, ten of the Home Command's hold scores agree. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 15.
addresses.evidence: Scores set beside OpenHOI3's on a load of July 1941: each difference was twice the missing ships, and none is left.

struct_fields.name: added_provinces_first
struct_fields.comment: A third province CList (tail +0x64, count +0x68) that CTheatre::AddProvince (0xAF950) appends to alongside the saved list at +0x30. 0x4AFD30 walks it and re-stamps province->+0x380/+0x384 for every member whose controller matches its argument. Whether CTheatre::SaveContents also writes it was not checked, so no claim is made that it is live-only. **After a load it holds the theatre's own provinces first and its fronts' after them**, though the save writes the fronts first (read on Golmud HQ and Vancouver HQ in the running game, 2026-11-10). Which of two hold positions of one score comes first follows this order. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 15.
struct_fields.evidence: The lists at +0x30 and +0x60 read in the running game: +0x60 begins with all of +0x30.
